# USAFacts' criteria and the framework built on them

**What this shows.** 4 of USAFacts' four criteria are kept and 3 added, 48 indicators in all, of which 23 have a current rule and 13 are measured, 12 of them on the cycle of record; 24 are specified only.

**Evidence-map claims.** `CL-047`, `CL-046`, `CL-048`, `CL-049`, `CL-050` (`docs/evidence/claims.yaml`).

**Note.** The measured count is the record's `counts.indicators_measured` (DD-055), the number the progress page and the brief print under the same name; measured on the cycle of record is the record's `measured_by.cycle` (DD-069). `scripts/score.py` calls what it scores "indicators scored", a different quantity.
